device: Philips 55OLED820/12, Philips Google TV TA5 (PH1M_WW_9972, MediaTek), Google TV 14
note: Key codes from Free My TV (Prefs.java, #437), TP Vision's own key codes read on a 65OLED910, also a Philips Google TV TA5; untested on a TV there and here. org.droidtv.GlobalKey hands the gear and the Apps button to launcherx, so they do nothing once it is off (examples/philips-google-tv-ta1/README.md logs them as scancodes 141 and 801). Free My TV's Apps button opens its All Apps; here it starts on Home. Netflix, YouTube and Prime Video keep working through GlobalKey and start empty, as does Guide. On this board a bound key filter costs the held-volume ramp (one step per press): see the same README.
